description: Source code for the Drupal 'Editor' entity class, defining a configurable text editor within Drupal's editor module, including properties, constructor, dependency calculation, and plugin management.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: Represents a configurable text editor entity in Drupal, managing editor plugin settings, dependencies, and associated filter formats.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the machine name of the text format for this editor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Editor object, loading default plugin settings if available.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the associated filter format.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies, including filter format and plugin provider.

methods.name: hasAssociatedFilterFormat
methods.description: Checks if the editor has an associated filter format.

methods.name: getFilterFormat
methods.description: Loads and returns the associated filter format entity.

methods.name: editorPluginManager
methods.description: Provides the plugin manager for editor plugins.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns the current editor plugin ID.

methods.name: getValidStreamWrappers
methods.description: Returns valid stream wrapper schemes for image uploads.
